provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.sources.exact_selection against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:select, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_declaration, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:validate_mutual_groups, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_case, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:scan, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:rule_citations_cannot_select_an_indented_siblings_constructor, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:rule_selections_preserve_final_literal_tokens, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::selects_mutual_inductive_members_and_surrounding_declarations, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::mutual_validation_ignores_comment_and_literal_decoys, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::rejects_unsupported_or_incomplete_mutual_groups_before_any_selection. The scanner masks comments/literals while retaining original selected text; extract_declaration rejects sibling commands and validates restricted column-zero mutual inductives before selection; extract_case chooses the minimum-indent named constructor and excludes siblings. Tests exercise indented sibling attacks, final literal tokens, complete mutual members and malformed/comment-decoy mutual groups. This remains textual selection, not elaboration. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
